title: feat(plugin-grid): right-clicking a list row opens its actions at the pointer; a row in a multi-row selection opens the bulk actions
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuF5qzfjTC1rAZK19osv9GA3)_

domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUp9U9hou7ccEhNS13

Fixes #28434

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：列表行右键在指针处打开该行的操作菜单（Open、Open in new tab，再加上与 ⋯ 同一解析器、同一谓词/权限门/顺序/确认的条目）；在 2 行以上选区内右键，则打开选区的批量操作（与 `BulkActionBar` 同源）或「N selected + Clear」。
- **为什么改**：行操作此前只能点右侧小小的 ⋯ 按钮；右键是用户已有的习惯，且不新增任何声明，只是同一组已声明操作的第二个入口。
- **风险与回滚**：链接、编辑中的单元格、输入框、选中文字、触屏长按仍走浏览器原生菜单；`DataTableSchema` 新增运行时槽位 `renderRowContextMenu`（函数，zod 镜像按名拒绝作者写入），不动 spec、不加翻译键。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` 的 `openRowContextMenu` / `keepsBrowserContextMenu` 与菜单外壳；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowContextMenu.tsx`；`ObjectGrid.tsx` 的 `renderRowContextMenu`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowContextMenu-28434.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-row-context-menu-28434.test.tsx` → 23 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One resolver per menu, read twice.** `RowActionMenu` is split into `useRowActionPlan` (capability gate, switch-off, `planRowActionMenu`) and `RowActionMenuItems`; the "⋮" cell and the context menu both render from them. `BulkActionBar`'s gating moves into `useBulkActionItems`, which the bar and the selection menu both read. `objectGridActionsColumn` exposes the exact props the "⋮" cell renders with (`rowActionMenuProps(row)`), so the context menu gets the same handlers and therefore the same confirm dialogs.
- **`data-table` owns the menu.** A controlled, non-modal Radix `DropdownMenu` anchored at the pointer (or below the focused cell for the context-menu key / Shift+F10), mounted only while open. Esc and a chosen item return focus to the cell it opened from. It keeps the browser's menu on `a[href]`, inputs / contenteditable, a cell in edit mode (`data-editing-cell`), a text selection inside the row, a touch long-press, and portalled menus/dialogs; and when there is nothing to offer.
- **New runtime slot `DataTableSchema.renderRowContextMenu(row, { selected })`.** The host returns `DropdownMenuItem`s or `null` (browser menu). The zod mirror refuses an authored value by name (`handlerKeyRefusal`, `runtime-slot`), recorded in the KnownDrift ledger (header pin 51 / 89).
- **`ObjectGrid` supplies the items.** A row in a selection of two or more gets `SelectionContextMenuItems` (count, bulk actions, Clear); any other row gets `RowContextMenuItems` (Open when the row click opens something, Open in new tab when the host publishes a record URL through `useRelatedRecordActions().recordHref`, then the row's actions).
- **Related-list tables** (no host renderer) get `data-table`'s own menu: Open (the row click), then exactly that row's "⋮" items from the extracted `useDataTableRowMenuPlan`. `plugin-detail` is not edited.

## Tests

- New `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowContextMenu-28434.test.tsx` (17), on the real `ObjectGrid` with real `ActionProvider` and a related-record host: per-row parity with the "⋮" menu (a row whose `visible` hides an action lacks it in both), the inline primary listed, Open / Open in new tab href, a custom action dispatching to its endpoint, no-host control; selection branch (bulk defs + count 3, no bulk → count + Clear and Clear clears, a row outside the selection and a selection of one get the row menu); native exceptions (link, edit cell, text selection, touch) with controls; Shift+F10, the context-menu key, Esc returns focus.
- New `components/.../data-table-row-context-menu-28434.test.tsx` (6): built-in related-list menu parity and a predicate removing an item from both, Open = row click, a 2+ selection and a table with no row menu keep the browser's menu; host renderer decides alone, `null` keeps the browser's menu, keyboard + focus return.
- Ablations via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each under `os-verify-lock` and restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty: link exception removed (1 failed), touch exception removed (1 failed), focus return removed (1 failed), selection branch removed (2 failed), inline budget 0 → 1 (1 failed), built-in selection guard removed (1 failed).
- `vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ packages/types/ packages/components/src/renderers/complex/`: 687 files, 13003 tests passed. After merging `origin/main`: `packages/types/` + the two new files + `ObjectGrid.declaredKeys-11068`: 388 files, 10475 passed.

## Screenshots (1440, app-crm Accounts)

Evidence commit `438798bb` (removed again in the next commit, so nothing reaches `main`).

- Row menu, same items and order as the row's "⋮" (Edit, Delete): ![row context menu](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/438798bb7606cd152f95f9839a8bbcc4f152b2e2/evidence/row-context-menu/row-context-menu-1440.png?raw=true)
- Three rows selected, right-click on one: count, the bar's bulk Delete, Clear: ![selection context menu](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/438798bb7606cd152f95f9839a8bbcc4f152b2e2/evidence/row-context-menu/selection-context-menu-1440.png?raw=true)

Read live in the same run: "⋮" items `["Edit","Delete"]`, context menu `["Open","Open in new tab","Edit","Delete"]`, selection menu `3 selected / Delete / Clear`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation (approved by the seat in the claim amendment 6546007567): inline primary actions are listed.** The "⋮" cell shows up to one primary action inline beside the trigger; a menu has no width budget, so the context menu lists every action the cell offers, primaries first where `planRowActionMenu` places them. On a row with an inline primary the context menu therefore has one more item than the "⋮" popup, never a different one.
- **Related-list tables have no Open in new tab and no selection branch.** `data-table`'s built-in menu has no record URL to open (the related-list host ignores the modifier payload) and no bulk actions, so a row inside a selection of two or more keeps the browser's menu there.
- **Clause-②: yes (widening)** per the claim amendment: `DataTableSchema` gains an optional runtime slot. No `packages/spec` file is touched; i18n reuses `table.open`, `detail.openInNewTab`, `grid.bulkSelected`, `grid.bulkClear` (present in all ten packs).
- A full-suite run first caught a regression in the byte ruler (`ObjectGrid.declaredKeys-11068`): an always-mounted closed menu drew a Radix trigger whose generated id differed between two identical renders. The menu is now mounted only while open; the ruler passes.
